dialogues.speaker: Rahetar
dialogues.text: F—Familiar?! H—How could I possibly be familiar with such an absurd thing?

dialogues.speaker: Rahetar
dialogues.text: "O mysterious maiden, even the greatest treasures of the Frostmoon Scions pale in comparison to your beauty and warmth"... "Now, be so kind as to return every last coin of that ill-gotten wealth"...

dialogues.speaker: Rahetar
dialogues.text: ...Obviously, I've never even had such ridiculous things said to me!

dialogues.speaker: Rahetar
dialogues.text: In... In any case, my dear Kasha can't be exposed to such frivolities! Children should focus on developing their virtues, until they become as pure as the moonlight!
